data.name: Nahydah
data.gender_notes: Nahydah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nahydah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'grace', 'kindness', 'favor'. The name Nahydah carries the meaning “Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nahydah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be gracious and kind to others.
data.etymology: Nahydah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahydah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نهيدة
in_arabic.meaning: نهيدة تعني الرفعة و العلو في الشأن و المكانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نهيدة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، و يعني الرفعة و العلو في الشأن و المكانة. و هي مشتقة من الفعل نهض، و نهضة تعني الارتفاع و الرفعة. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نیہدہ
in_urdu.meaning: نیہدہ کا مطلب ہے رفعت و علو شان و مقام
in_urdu.long_meaning: نیہدہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے رفعت و علو شان و مقام۔ یہ فعل نہض سے مشتق ہے، اور نہضة کا مطلب ہے ارتفاع و رفعت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورت و ستائش کے مستحق معانیを持つ ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नहيدة
in_hindi.meaning: नहيدة का अर्थ है रफ़्तार और उच्च स्थान
in_hindi.long_meaning: नहيدة एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है, और इसका अर्थ है रफ़्तार और उच्च स्थान। यह क्रिया नहद से व्युत्पन्न है, और नहदा का अर्थ है ऊंचाई और रफ़्तार। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदर और प्रशंसनीय अर्थों वाले नामों में से एक है।

in_pashto.name: نهيده
in_pashto.meaning: نهيده د لوړوالي او عزت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نهيده د ښځينو يو نوم دی چې عربي ريښې لري، او د لوړوالي او عزت معنی لري. دا د نهض فعل څخه اخستل شوی دی، او نهضة د لوړيدن او رفعت معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په کلتور کې د ستاين او ښايسته معاني لرونکی نومونو څخه يو دی.

in_english.name: Nahydah
in_english.meaning: elevated status, high rank, or noble position
in_english.long_meaning: Nahydah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'nahada' which means 'to rise' or 'to elevate'. It signifies elevated status, high rank, or noble position. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with positive qualities such as dignity, honor, and prestige. The name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and timeless significance.

data.cultural_impact: Nahydah is a unique name that exudes beauty and kindness, often making an impact on those who hear it. In many Muslim communities, giving a child a meaningful name is seen as a blessing and a source of pride. The name Nahydah can instill virtues of compassion, grace, and kindness in a young girl, fostering strong relationships and a positive impact on her community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, kindness and compassion are highly valued virtues. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "None of you will enter Paradise until he is forgiven for the sin he committed between his two jawbones." (Bukhari). The name Nahydah can serve as a constant reminder of the importance of these virtues in one's daily life and spiritual journey. It reflects the teachings of the Quran and Hadith, encouraging one to be kind, generous, and compassionate towards others, ultimately drawing them closer to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Grace" symbolizes Nahydah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'grace', 'kindness', 'favor'.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nahydah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of grace.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nahydah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari. The name Nahydah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nahydah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari as a man who was present during the Battle of Uhud and was given the title 'the man with the two lights' due to his bright eyes.
